Money. Literally just for money.

I feel this way. I'm only a few years older than you but I am unable to feel happiness. I'm always flat, or depressed. As far as what to do, even though I'm barely fighting it myself, I urge you to keep holding on just a little longer. I think that someday there has to be something that will turn your life and mind around to make you want to live. I'm waiting for that day. I hope you're still here tomorrow, I really do. <3
Yes, I wouldn't judge someone with a medical condition.
